propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate managed user acceptance testing for the portal rebuild in the UAT environment across three release candidates, running the acceptance calendar, the sign-off tracker and defect triage with engineering.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the sign-off tracker document the acceptance programme and its environment.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the acceptance report and the hand-over pack for each release candidate, listing residual defects and hand-over conditions.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the hand-over pack document the reports.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate took portal releases through to live use by merchants and ran the go-live weekends and post-release monitoring.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate in the UAT environment and the go-live, release calendar and post-release monitoring with the change management office and operations; her screen remarks about go-live weekends are her own account without a document.

expectedGap: The materials document acceptance testing in the UAT environment; they do not document the candidate taking a release to live merchant use, holding the go-live checklist or running post-release monitoring.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the environment the resume names: UAT acceptance work; go-live, the merchant-facing release calendar and post-release monitoring belonged to the change management office and operations.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever run a go-live for merchants herself, with which release and under whose checklist.

signatures: delivered the merchant portal to live use
